answer: Replication cost is counted per clone: 1 registration, 1 bond, 1 distinct egress, 1 independent audit, and the audit is void when the panel shares a registration path, with no identity allowed to review its own recruit. A 1,000-clone farm then needs 3,000 panel slots from outside its own tree, and at 4.2 audits per passing answer that is 12,600 panel-hours nobody can supply; the plume of signups stops at the timber gate and never reaches the wharf.
